name: spec-sync

# Spec Sync

Read `SPEC.md`, the user's request and the actual code diff. Identify changed requirements, interfaces, assumptions, metrics and limitations. Update only affected sections of `SPEC.md` to match verified implementation, never speculative plans or guessed results. Flag ambiguities for user review. Summarize precisely what changed in the spec. Do not silently rewrite other project files.
